scope: Operator qualification of four installed Toolkit reads against one existing manifest-owned original sandbox capture and already-bound dispute; not a native-agent grant test

operations.name: paypal_get_order
operations.disclosure: A current read of the exact owned sandbox resource. This read does not change the workspace T/K projection.

operations.name: paypal_list_disputes
operations.disclosure: A current, bounded summary page. Capture ownership comes from the exact previously verified case bindings, not the query filter. Unknown cases are refused; an empty page does not establish that no disputes exist. This read does not change the workspace T/K projection.

operations.name: paypal_get_dispute
operations.disclosure: A current read of the exact owned sandbox resource. This read does not change the workspace T/K projection.

operations.name: paypal_find_transaction
operations.disclosure: A current, bounded reporting read. Reporting can lag; absence in this page does not establish a missing capture. This read does not change the workspace T/K projection.

limits: Separate operator qualification, not a native agent permission test.
Original failed summary-response qualification is retained unchanged. The corrected run validates versioned, previously verified case bindings before and after the bounded summary read.
Reporting and case summaries are bounded pages; missing rows do not prove absence.
The exact-order capture status and transaction-reporting status are independent provider observations; this run does not reconcile or overwrite canonical financial state.
No new recovery action, approval, buyer consent, or financial write.
